name: Cerro Llao Llao
region: Parque Municipal Llao Llao, Circuito Chico
why: A short forest climb to the best view of the Llao Llao peninsula: Lago Nahuel Huapi, Lago Moreno and the hotel below.
book: Pay the Parque Municipal Llao Llao entry online or by the QR code at the gate. Open 08:00-22:00 in summer; closed on windy days. Bus 20 to Puerto Pañuelo (km 25 of Avenida Bustillo).
water: None on the trail; café at the information centre.
dangers: The last stretch to the top is steep with roots and loose soil.
Trails close in strong wind: falling branches.
turnaround: None needed: about an hour up.

points.name: Llao Llao forest trailhead
points.note: 300 m past the Llao Llao information centre, on the right of the Circuito Chico road. The path climbs through coihue and cypress forest.

points.name: Cerro Llao Llao lookout
points.note: 1,025 m. Lago Nahuel Huapi, Lago Moreno and the Llao Llao hotel on its peninsula below.
